options.description: Override the API base URL.

options.name: --json
options.description: Render structured responses as raw JSON instead of human-readable text. [default: False]

options.description: Write response content to this file path instead of stdout.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Write one file per returned item when the response contains multiple resources.

commands.name: speak-with-sse
commands.description:
Text to speech over SSE
Generate speech from text using Server-Sent Events. Each event contains
base64 encoded audio plus the source text and sampling rate.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Optional API key query parameter supported by the SSE transport.

options.name: --jwt-token
options.description: Optional JWT token query parameter returned by the SSE auth endpoint.

options.name: --text
options.description: Text to synthesize.

options.name: --speed
options.description: Playback speed. Values are snapped by the service to slow, normal, or fast.

options.name: --temperature
options.description: Randomness introduced into text-to-speech generation.

options.name: --lang-code
options.description: Language code for the desired language.

options.name: --voice-id
options.description: Voice ID to use for synthesis.

options.name: --sampling-rate
options.description: Sampling rate of returned audio.

options.name: --encoding
options.description: Encoding of returned audio.

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Optional output format for generated audio.
